label: Leaving parental home for the first time
subject: self
notes: University and non-university merged; split if footprint differs.

label: First private or social tenancy
subject: self
notes: Partial via deposit protection and council tax; RRA thread from other chat lands here.

label: First paid employment
subject: self
notes: Partial via PAYE / HMRC RTI.

label: Moving in with a partner
subject: self
notes: Partial via loss of single-person council tax discount only.

label: Marriage or civil partnership
subject: self
notes: GRO registered.

label: First child by birth
subject: self
notes: Nine-month run-up is planned by definition even if conception was not.

label: First child by adoption
subject: self
notes: Longer administrative tail.

label: First purchase alone
subject: self
notes: Land Registry PPD.

label: First purchase with a partner
subject: self
notes: Land Registry PPD.

label: First purchase funded partly by gift or inheritance
subject: self
notes: Exists to carry bereavement -> inheritance -> purchase link. May belong as edge attribute; see codebook ambiguity 1.

label: Home move after first purchase or tenancy
subject: self
notes: Registered if owner-occupied; partial if rented.

label: Job change or promotion
subject: self
notes: Partial via PAYE.

label: Redundancy after consultation period
subject: self
notes: Partial via Universal Credit / JSA claims and HR1 notifications.

label: Sudden job loss
subject: self
notes: Includes insolvency and dismissal.

label: Own serious illness diagnosis
subject: self
notes: No public trace except benefits (PIP/ESA). Panel data only; see codebook ambiguity 3.

label: Becoming carer for a parent
subject: self
notes: Partial only if Carer's Allowance claimed; see codebook ambiguity 2.

label: Becoming carer for a partner
subject: self
notes: Often precedes bereavement.partner_anticipated.

label: Becoming carer for a disabled child
subject: self
notes: Partial via DLA for children.

label: Divorce or dissolution as initiator
subject: self
notes: Court registered. Agency mixed at class level; split resolves it.

label: Divorce or dissolution as non-initiator
subject: self
notes: Lead time varies; shock is the modal case.

label: Separation of cohabiting couple
subject: self
notes: No legal process; arguably a separate class. See codebook ambiguity 5.

label: Death of a parent after illness
subject: self
notes: GRO death registration; probate; Tell Us Once. Anchor case.

label: Sudden death of a parent
subject: self
notes: Same administrative tail; no pre-event signal.

label: Death of a partner after illness
subject: self
notes: Working-age cases behaviourally distinct; see codebook ambiguity 4.

label: Death of a child
subject: self
notes: Includes stillbirth in registration terms.

label: Planned retirement
subject: self
notes: Partial via State Pension claim and PAYE cessation.

label: Retirement forced by health or redundancy
subject: self
notes: Overlaps redundancy and serious_illness_diagnosis.

label: Moving into residential care
subject: self
notes: Partial via local authority needs assessment. Often triggers subsequent_home_move for the household.

label: Own death after illness
subject: household
notes: Household acts; person does not. Mirror of bereavement variants.
